caseNameFull: Thorp v. Board of Trustees, Newark College of Engineering
attorneys: Samuel L. Rothbard 'for petitioner., Theodore D. Parsons, Attorney General of New Jersey, and Joseph A. Murphy, Assistant Deputy Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. It appearing that the cause has become moot, the judgment of the Supreme Court of New Jersey is vacated and the cause is remanded for such proceedings as by that Court may be deemed appropriate.
